# A function to obtain and process sgRNA library Log-fold-change data

```{r}

obtain_required_data <- function(library, normalized_lfc_data, stratification_data) {
  
  library <- read_tsv(library, col_names = FALSE)
  colnames(library) <- c("sgRNA", "spacer", "gene")
  
  normalized_lfc_data <- read_csv(normalized_lfc_data)
  library_stratification <- read_csv(stratification_data, col_types = cols(alignment_bin = col_character()
  )) %>% select(sgRNA, alignment_bin)
  
  # left join
  library_lfc_data <- normalized_lfc_data %>%
    left_join(library, by = c("sgRNA", "spacer", "gene")) %>%
    relocate(sgRNA, .before = spacer) %>%
    relocate(gene, .after = spacer) %>%
    arrange(sgRNA)
  
  
  terms <- c("CONTROL", "Control", "control", "INTRON", "Intron", "intron", "LacZ", "luciferase")
  # lacZ and luciferase are the control in Toronto V3 library
  terms_for_filtering <- paste(terms, collapse = "|")
  
  # separate control from the library

  control_lfc_data <- library_lfc_data %>% filter(str_detect(gene, terms_for_filtering))
  
  library_lfc_data <- library_lfc_data %>%
    filter(!str_detect(gene, terms_for_filtering)) %>%
    left_join(library_stratification, join_by(sgRNA)) %>%
    filter(alignment_bin %in% c(0, 1, 2, 3, 4, 5,"> 5"))
  
  library_lfc_data$alignment_bin <- factor(library_lfc_data$alignment_bin, levels = c(0, 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, "> 5"))
  
  return(library_lfc_data)
  
}


calculate_spearman_corr <- function(input_data) {
  
  input_data$alignment_bin_num <- as.numeric(ifelse(input_data$alignment_bin == "> 5", 7, input_data$alignment_bin))
  
  # turn this on if you'd like to use the median of all sgRNA LFC (because the data is skewed)
  # median_df <- input_data %>%
  #   group_by(alignment_bin_num) %>%
  #   summarize(median_LFC = median(mean))
  
  spearman_test <- cor.test(input_data$alignment_bin_num, as.numeric(input_data$mean), method="spearman", alternative="less")
  
  paste("spearman corr rho: ", spearman_test$estimate)
  paste("spearman pvalue: ", format.pval(spearman_test$p.value, digits=5))
  
  return(list(spearman_test, input_data))
}

visualize_lfc <- function(library_lfc_data, boxplot_output_name, spearman_rho, spearman_p) {
  
  x <- library_lfc_data$mean[library_lfc_data$alignment_bin == "0"]  # values for group 0
  stats <- boxplot.stats(x)$stats  # min, 25%, median, 75%, max
  # stats[5] is upper whisker
  
  boxplot_lfc <- library_lfc_data %>%
    ggplot(aes(alignment_bin, mean, group = alignment_bin)) +
    geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA, size = 1) +
    geom_smooth(aes(x = as.numeric(alignment_bin_num), y = mean),
                method = "lm", se = FALSE) +
    theme_minimal() +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "black", size = 1) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = -1, linetype = "dashed", color = "black", size = 1) +
    scale_y_continuous(limits = c(-3.5, 3.5), breaks = seq(-3, 3, by = 1)) +
    labs(title = "", 
         x = "Number of perfect on-target alignment", 
         y = "Averaged median sgRNA Log2FC") +
    theme(plot.margin = margin(10, 10, 25, 10),
          axis.text.x = element_text(size = 40, vjust = 0.7, colour = "black"),
          axis.text.y = element_text(size = 40, colour = "black"),
          axis.title.x = element_text(size = 40, vjust = 0.5, margin = margin(t = 20)),
          axis.title.y = element_text(size = 40, vjust = 0.5, margin = margin(r = 20)),
          panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
          panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
          axis.line.x = element_line(size = 0.5),
          axis.line.y = element_line(size = 0.5), 
          line = element_line((size = 4), colour = 'black')) +
    annotate("text", 
             x = 2,                             # x position inside plot
             y = -2.5,       # y position above boxes
             label = paste0("Spearman ρ=", round(spearman_rho,2),
                            "\np=", spearman_p),
             hjust = 0.5,                       # center horizontally
             size = 10, color = "black") +
    stat_compare_means(comparisons = list(c("0","1"), c("0","2"), c("0","3"), c("0","4"), c("0","5"), c("0","> 5")),
                       method = "wilcox.test",
                       p.adjust.method = "BH",
                       size = 6.5,
                       step.increase = -0.025,
                       label.y = c(stats[5], (stats[5]+0.5), (stats[5]+1), (stats[5]+1.5), (stats[5]+2), (stats[5]+2.5)))
    
  ggsave(
    path = './',
    width = 15,
    height = 15,
    dpi = 300,
    plot = boxplot_lfc,
    filename = boxplot_output_name)
  
}


```

# Avana Library

```{r}

avana_library_and_lfc_data <- obtain_required_data("../data/library_data/avana_library.tsv", 
                                                   "../data/sgrna_lfc_data/output_normalized/avana_normalized_lfc.csv", 
                                                   "../data/sgrna_lfc_data/avana_data/avana_stratify_single_mismatch.csv")

avana_spearman <- calculate_spearman_corr(avana_library_and_lfc_data)

# Basic Kruskal–Wallis test
kruskal.test(avana_library_and_lfc_data$mean ~ avana_library_and_lfc_data$alignment_bin, data = avana_library_and_lfc_data)

# Post-hoc pairwise comparisons (non-parametric)
pairwise.wilcox.test(avana_library_and_lfc_data$mean, avana_library_and_lfc_data$alignment_bin, p.adjust.method = "BH")

# wilcoxon test effect size
avana_library_and_lfc_data$alignment_bin <- factor(avana_library_and_lfc_data$alignment_bin, levels = c("0","1","2","3","4","5","> 5"))
avana_wilcox_effect <- wilcox_effsize(avana_library_and_lfc_data, formula = mean ~ alignment_bin, paired = FALSE, conf.level = 0.95)

visualize_lfc(avana_spearman[[2]],
              "../figure/03_fig_analysis_lfc_off-target-sgrna/avana_lfc_single_mismatch.png",
              avana_spearman[[1]]$estimate,
              format.pval(avana_spearman[[1]]$p.value, digits=5))

```
